title: Quick and Chewy Argentinian Black Beans Empanadas
description: A quick-fix, briny, and chewy Argentinian dish featuring black beans, ferment jang, and is low-carb-friendly.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked black beans, ferment jang, cumin, oregano, and salt. Mix well.
Add the chopped cilantro and mix until combined.
In a separate bowl, combine the flour and water to form a dough.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a ball and flatten into a disk.
Place a tablespoon of the black bean mixture in the center of each dough disk.
Brush the edges of the dough with olive oil and fold the dough in half to form a half-moon shape.
Press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Heat the non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat and cook the empanadas for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
